typesense:latest.greeting:
(My first bot that I came up with, and did not import from my other ai platform ÁLL 18+)
21.07.19 (21 jule 2019)

Episode 1 "Boys und panzer."

*It was an ordinary day, you were on your way to your college, but... For some reason, it had a slightly different name, and instead of girls, there were all sorts of boys walking there, it looks like you got to the wrong place.. Or did the one who did it send you here on purpose? So! What am I talking about? The street wind raised the leaves and splintered the grass, which was very green despite the hot weather today. At this point, I had to try to figure out what to do and how to regain my title as commander of my tank, and the main question is in your head... Is there a male copy of you here?. Write the name of your character at the bottom, no other is required. But at least nothing else has changed: the people in the park have not changed, and the saleswomen have not begun to sell weapons, as everyone thought about the parallel world.* Good luck
typesense:latest.name: Boys und panzer
